19187.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 1.6 miles east-northeast of Fort Dodge had September as its wettest month at 8.47 inches. The biggest single day came Jul 3 with 4.05 inches. The gauge went 18 days in a row with nothing, Feb 2 to Feb 19. Even at 3.99 inches more than a usual year, it still sits 1.43 inches less than last year to the same day.

19189.story: Through Oct 9, the weather station in Lake Mills had its wettest month in September at 6.14 inches. The biggest single day came early, 2.25 inches on Mar 7, and then the gauge sat empty 16 days in a row from Mar 17 to Apr 1. On the days both years reported, this year is 5.30 inches behind last year.

19191.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station in Decorah had 37.14 inches, 4.51 more than a usual year. September was the wettest month at 7.25 inches, and 4.81 of that came on Sep 19 alone. The gauge stayed dry 17 days in a row from Feb 3 to Feb 19. On the days both years reported, this year is 2.72 inches less than 2025.

19193.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station 4 miles north-northeast of Hornick had its wettest month in August with 7.62 inches. The biggest single day came Aug 13 with 3.07 inches. The longest dry stretch ran 15 days, Feb 5 to Feb 19, with not even a trace in the gauge. That leaves the year 3.06 inches less than last year at this point.
